resources.string: System controls are unavailable in this version. Use the Fire TV remote or system settings.
This version opens as a regular app. Home button takeover and background services are unavailable.
Installing and updating apps is unavailable in this version. Existing apps are unchanged.
Removing apps is unavailable in this version. You can manage installed apps in your device settings.
These Apple presentation downloads are unavailable. You can use your own images and videos.
This version uses compatibility media quality. Higher quality has not been tested on this device.
System screensaver and idle settings are unchanged. The photo preview is available in Control Center.
